datasheet_identity.title: M1 THRU M7 Surface Mount General Purpose Rectifier

extraction_notes: M1 is the 50 V member of the M1 THRU M7 family; the p. 1 maximum-rating table lists VRRM = VDC = 50 V for M1.
The electrical-characteristics table gives IR1 = 2 uA at rated DC blocking voltage and Ta = 25 degC, and IR2 = 200 uA at Ta = 125 degC; the 25 degC row is recorded as the reverse-current spec.
The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time.
The forward-voltage and reverse-characteristic plots are family curves labeled M1 THRU M7; curve coordinates are direct readings from the plotted traces, not interpolated datasheet table values.
omission_reason: Reverse recovery time and breakdown current are not published in the supplied datasheet.
